$comment: The packs this repository generates components for. Each is read from git at the pinned commit `ref` (a full SHA, never a branch), from the sibling checkout `checkout` when it holds that commit, else by a shallow fetch of `repository`. Adding a pack is a new entry here; moving a pack forward is a new `ref`. `minIcons` is the floor the count guard enforces, set a little under the measured count. `licence` is the artwork's SPDX expression; attribution files are found by convention, read at `ref`: the pack's ATTRIBUTION.md and every file under resources/assets/svg/licenses/, copied to dist/<flavour>/<pack>/; an optional `attribution` list overrides that for a pack that needs it, and an entry that names no file fails the build. `exclude` lists source SVGs the policy rejects, each with its reason; an entry that stops being rejected fails the build. A private pack is never listed here: a public package cannot ship it.

packs.$comment: Twemoji, the pack's only set since ichava/icon-sets-twemoji#99 moved OpenMoji to ichava/icon-sets-openmoji, which the openmoji entry generates. It has one licence file (licenses/twemoji/license), so the attribution convention needs no explicit list.
